chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who married while she already had a husband, he said:
“The woman is to be stoned, and if the one who married her has proof concerning her marriage, [then that is considered]; otherwise, the hadd punishment is administered.”

key_terms.اِمْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.تَزَوَّجَتْ: she married; entered into a marriage contract
key_terms.تَزْوِيجِهَا: her being married off or contracted in marriage
key_terms.تُرْجَمُ: she is stoned; the prescribed punishment in this case
key_terms.زَوْجٌ: a husband; indicating a pre-existing marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman marries while she already has a husband?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who enters a marriage while already having a husband. It states the ruling upon the woman and distinguishes the legal outcome for the man based on whether he possesses proof that the marriage was contracted on valid grounds.
